title: Possible type 1 diabetes in a child
presentation: A child with possible type 1 diabetes; typical symptoms are polyuria, polydipsia, weight loss and tiredness. Age to be added.

pathway.title: Suspected T1DM
pathway.mermaid:
flowchart TD
 A[Symptoms of diabetes] --> B[Same-day capillary glucose and ketones]
 B --> C{Glucose raised or ketones present}
 C -- Yes --> D[Same-day referral to paediatric diabetes team or emergency admission]
 C -- No --> E[Consider other causes and safety-net]
 D --> F[Do not delay for HbA1c]

investigations.test: Venous gas and U&E in hospital

management: Same-day specialist referral for suspected T1DM; do not wait for an HbA1c.
Unwell, vomiting or ketotic: emergency admission.
Do not start treatment in the community.
Support the family: explain clearly, address fear, and signpost to the team.
Safety-netting: urgent review if vomiting, abdominal pain, drowsiness or fast breathing.
pearls: Think of diabetes in a child with bedwetting after being dry.
Capillary glucose is quick and cheap: do it.
lookUp: NICE NG18 diagnosis and DKA management

selfTest.q: What 2 tests in clinic confirm the urgency?
